archetype: Modern Tactical EdTech (Hybrid: Soft Utility + Performance EdTech)
emotional_tone: Inviting, empowering, futuristic yet approachable, structured, child-friendly without looking childish

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace
rules: DO NOT use Inter or Arial for main headings; use Outfit or Manrope for an energetic, professional edtech feel.
Headlines > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines / badges MUST be uppercase with letter spacing tracking-wider or tracking-widest.
In lab workspaces, code panels MUST strictly use mono_font with syntax coloring.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-5 or p-6) to avoid text colliding with edges.
Dashboards follow High Density Grid rules (MODE B) with 1px crisp borders, elevated headers, and zero awkward empty space.
Student learning dashboard uses friendly oversized progress indicators, visual lab entrance cards with vibrant accent borders.
Desktop-first responsive design for student learning views & labs, while admin/trainer dashboards scale down seamlessly to mobile.

navigation_and_header.styles: bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border sticky top-0 z-50 transition-colors duration-200
requirements: Every dashboard layout MUST feature a crisp navbar with Logo, Role Badge ('Super Admin', 'Center Admin', 'Trainer', 'Student'), Center Selector / License status indicator, Offline/Online Sync pill, Theme Switcher, and User Profile menu.
Header must NOT be fully transparent; use glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md with semi-opaque background.
Include explicit data-testid attributes on logo, role-switcher, offline status indicator, and navigation links.

super_admin.focus: Global center oversight, software licenses, curriculum distribution, trainer assignments, and revenue/usage metrics.
key_components: License quota gauge and expiration countdown cards
Tuition center network map/table with active student counts
Global analytics line charts (Monthly active students, Offline sync health)

center_admin.focus: Local center management: Student batches, local trainers, student attendance, center license usage.
key_components: Batch status grid (Active classes, Trainer assigned, Student enrollment capacity)
Local center performance stats (Lesson completion rates, Quiz averages)

trainer.focus: Classroom instruction, project reviews, grading student quizzes, monitoring real-time lab progress.
key_components: Student table with completion badges, last active lab, quiz scores
Project approval queue (Approve/Feedback modal for coding and game projects)
Quick quiz trigger / classroom leaderboard toggle

student.focus: Engaging, gamified learning path, interactive lab launcher, continue learning cards, and earned achievements.
key_components: Personalized Welcome Card ('Welcome back, Alex! Ready to code?')
Continue Learning card with high-contrast progress bar & 'Jump Back In' CTA button
Overall Stats Ring (Overall progress %, Course completed, Projects submitted, Quiz score average)
Interactive Lab Entrance Cards (Coding Lab, Game Lab, Robotics Simulator, AI Lab)
Achievements / Badges showcase with unlock tooltips & certificate downloader

blockly_coding_lab.layout: Left: Block Categories Palette (Logic, Loops, Math, Text, Variables, Actions) | Center: Visual Workspace with drag-drop visual blocks | Right: Generated Code (JS/Python toggle) + Live Canvas/Console Output | Bottom: Run, Stop, Reset, Save Offline buttons
blockly_coding_lab.style: Clean dark/light theme options, vibrant category colors for blocks (Orange for Logic, Teal for Loops, Violet for Actions), high-contrast Run button (#10B981)

game_lab_2d.layout: Starter Templates list (Pong, Maze Runner, Space Shooter, Platformer) | Code / Config Editor | 2D HTML5 Canvas preview screen | Inspector controls
game_lab_2d.style: Arcade-inspired dark frame around 2D canvas (#020617) with retro retro-glow status indicators and quick restart/debug buttons

robotics_simulator.layout: Interactive 2D Grid Board (Obstacles, Power-ups, Sensor Rays, Target Cell) | Command Sequence Builder / Code Panel (Forward, Turn Left, Turn Right, Sense Distance, Pick Up) | Real-time Robot Execution Animation | Sensor Telemetry Panel
robotics_simulator.style: Tactical grid aesthetics (#1E293B background with cyan sensor rays, animated robot icon, emerald target flag, ruby obstacles)

quiz_system.layout: Card-based question interface | Stepper progress indicator | Single/Multiple choice radio/checkbox choices | Immediate feedback mode or timed exam mode | Result breakdown card with explanation
quiz_system.style: Generous spacing, smooth transition on option selection, distinct success green (#10B981) and error crimson (#EF4444) callouts

micro_interactions_and_motion.hover_effects: Card hover: subtle -translate-y-1 transform with shadow-md to shadow-xl elevation; button hover: distinct contrast boost and active scale effect (active:scale-95).
micro_interactions_and_motion.transitions: Explicit property transitions only: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out, transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out. NO universal transition: all.
micro_interactions_and_motion.badges_and_achievements: Unlocking achievement plays subtle sparkle confetti or glow frame, highlighting mastery.
micro_interactions_and_motion.offline_first_indicator: Live status pill: 'Offline Mode (Local Storage Synced)' in amber (#F59E0B) or 'Online (Synced)' in emerald (#10B981) at header.

testing_guidelines.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, unique for all interactive and key metrics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color tokens and typography scale defined in design_guidelines.json.
Use pre-built Shadcn UI components located at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/ (Dialog, Card, Select, Tabs, Table, Progress, Badge, Sonner for notifications).
Ensure the app works offline-first using localStorage/IndexedDB fallback for tuition centers with low/no connectivity.
Implement clear role-based switching or seamless demo role selector so reviewers can easily test Super Admin, Center Admin, Trainer, and Student dashboards.
Include full interactive labs: Blockly Block Coding, 2D Game Lab with HTML5 canvas, and 2D Robotics simulator grid with obstacles and distance sensors.
Add test-ids (data-testid) to all buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, and key statistics.
